thread:
alex: Quick ask — we have a hybrid inference sweep next Tue 03:00-07:00 PST and need a shortburst quota bump across clouds. Primary plan: 8 H100s in apac (asia-south1) + 6 A100s in eu-west1. Can vendors confirm available slots or a firm ETA?

vendor-liaison-bot: Listening. Vendor partner reports limited H100 availability in apac this week. Can we accept mixed SKU fallback (4 H100 + 4 L40s) or require full H100? ETA for additional H100 racks: ~72h (pending PO ack).

alex: We can accept mixed SKU if performance tests stay within latency SLO (p95 < 200ms). Prefer H100 but ok with L40s for some load. 

mike: If apac fails, can we route traffic to our Dedicated eu-pool instead of bursting on cloud? That avoids multi-vendor procurement delays. Anyone on-call for dedicated pool sizing?

alex: Good call. Tanya, can you check dedicated pool headroom for Tue morning? Also need a Terraform PR for the shortburst carve so billing + quotas align.

tanya: On it. I pushed a draft PR for the terraform carve — link: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/812 (please review). Snippet below for the resource we need to bump:

```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_quota" "shortburst_apac" {
  region = "asia-south1"
  sku = "h100"
  count = 8
  window = "2025-06-10T03:00:00Z/2025-06-10T07:00:00Z"
}
```

sophie: Quick cost FYI — if we go full H100 for 8hrs across both regions, rough ballpark is ~$12k. Mixed SKU with L40s drops to ~7k. Finops, can you confirm?

finops: Confirming. Estimate range: H100-heavy scenario $11.2k–13.5k, mixed-sku $6.8k–8.1k. Also, if vendor charges surge pricing for short notice, add ~15%. We need explicit approval for anything >$10k.

mike: Ops question — if vendor can't deliver H100s in apac, can we run a canary of the sweep on L40s first to validate quality before scaling? That keeps rollout safe.

vendor-liaison-bot: Canary OK. Vendor can provision 2 H100 + 2 L40 canary slice in ~12h, full mixed carve in 24–36h, full H100 only once PO confirmed (~72h).

alex: Plan proposal: 1) Approve mixed-sku shortburst (fallback to L40s) 2) Run 2 H100+2 L40 canary 6h prior to window 3) If canary passes, scale to full mixed carve 4) Parallel: Tanya to open PR for Dedicated pool fallback route and wire a routing policy in the runbook. Anyone object? :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.

sophie: :thumbsup: from finance side if we stay under $10k. If estimate hits >10k, need written approval from LP.

tanya: I'll add the dedicated-pool routing config to the PR and a short runbook step for automatic failover (priority: dedicated -> vendor fallback -> region failover).

alex: Thanks. Mike can you be on standby Tue 01:00 PST to watch canary metrics? I’ll ping oncall if vendor slips.

mike: Yes, I can. Will monitor p95/p99, GPU util, OOMs.

finops: Noted — I’ll flag spend to LP if estimate trends >10k.

vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor will start pre-provisioning on PO confirmation. Please send PO and confirm network peering windows.

alex: Sending PO now (internal ticket #INF-4521). Tanya — can you merge the PR and tag the routing runbook?
